report:
Reviewed the complete storage claim and the full associated evidence set: one ordinary implementation in check/sig.rs and the sole TODO test sage_meta::todo::checking_signature_storage, both without cfg qualifications. Baseline: independently compared current sig.rs and semantic_spec.rs with the historical input snapshots; both are exact byte matches. The historical rationale remains consistent with the current inputs, but is not treated as proof of completed coverage.

Fresh source assessment: Check keeps the borrowed source_stash separate from a newly created owned target_stash. Parameter-environment collection reads target-stash predicates and complete_parameter_env allocates the combined predicate slice there. finish consumes Check and passes the target stash and root to Stashed::new, preserving the intended result ownership boundary. This accounts for the demonstrated storage mechanism. The stronger claim covers every checked type, binder, predicate and retained alias application and forbids references into parser state or the source CST stash; finish alone cannot establish that every reachable pointer satisfies that condition.

The complete associated test body contains only an explicit TODO and no behavioral assertions. Its stated prerequisite is structural snapshot traversal of representative completed signatures after parser/source-stash borrows end, including retained aliases and predicates and cross-stash pointer detection. That verification matrix must cover types and binders as part of the representative signatures as well. A misplaced nested pointer would not be caught by the present empty test. This is a justified, visible deferral matching the prior rationale, not evidence that lifetime independence or all recursive allocations have been verified. No additional edits are needed to the existing accounting; comprehensive implementation assurance and behavioral verification remain deferred under this TODO.

Execution: ran review start and exact snapshot comparisons, then review record. No behavior tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and a root cargo build passing; those results do not establish this TODO claim. No additional helper source was relied on beyond the captured initial fragments.
